BackstoryDef.title: blood cultist
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is a member of a minor cult that worships an aspect of Khorne, God of Blood. [PAWN_pronoun] is fanatically devoted to [PAWN_possessive] god, but unstable, and looked down on by the more organised and disciplined Blood Pact.

BackstoryDef.title: Militarum deserter
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was conscripted into the Astra Militarum and trained in the use of a lasgun and bayonet. [PAWN_pronoun] deserted and ended up joining the Blood Pact, where [PAWN_pronoun] is treated better than [PAWN_pronoun] ever was in [PAWN_possessive] former regiment.

BackstoryDef.title: Militarum convert
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was conscripted into the Astra Militarum and trained in the use of a lasgun and bayonet. Taken prisoner by Blood Pact forces, [PAWN_pronoun] was offered the chance to join as long as [PAWN_pronoun] embraced the worship of Khorne.

BackstoryDef.title: Blood Pact soldier
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was inducted into the forces of the Blood Pact and trained in the ways of war. [PAWN_pronoun] is proficient with numerous weapons, used to performing field maintenance of [PAWN_possessive] gear, and utterly committed to the service of the Gaur and the Lord of Blood.

BackstoryDef.title: Blood Pact marksman
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was inducted into the forces of the Blood Pact and trained in the ways of war. [PAWN_pronoun] showed a particular aptitude for marksmanship, and is used to being deployed as a sniper in engagements against the Imperium's forces.

BackstoryDef.title: Blood Pact sawbones
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was inducted into the forces of the Blood Pact and trained in the ways of war, including the ways of keeping people fighting after wounds are sustained. [PAWN_possessive] methods may be crude by the standards of 'civilised' Imperial medicae, but they work, and many Pact warriors have survived to kill again under [PAWN_possessive] knife.

BackstoryDef.title: Blood Pact tank crew
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was inducted into the forces of the Blood Pact and trained in the ways of war, particularly the operation of armoured vehicles. [PAWN_pronoun] is able to wield these wheeled and tracked machines as weapons in the name of the Blood God, as well as patiently maintaining [PAWN_possessive] charge.

BackstoryDef.title: Death Brigadier
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was inducted into the forces of the Blood Pact and elevated to the elite Death Brigade, a unit of storm troopers and unyielding fighters, for [PAWN_possessive] bravery and martial prowess. [PAWN_pronoun] is utterly committed to the service of the Gaur and the Lord of Blood.

BackstoryDef.title: Sirdar
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was inducted into the forces of the Blood Pact and trained in the ways of war, and given the rank of Sirdar for [PAWN_possessive] faithful service and skill at arms. [PAWN_pronoun] is used to command, and is a dangerous warrior to boot.

BackstoryDef.title: Gore Mage
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is a Gore Mage, a psyker dedicated to Khorne, the Brazen King. [PAWN_pronoun] knows bloody rituals that can bring visions and track enemies.

BackstoryDef.title: cultist child
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised among a cult worshipping the Ruinous Powers. [PAWN_pronoun] was involved in dark rituals from an early age and took great delight in participating.

BackstoryDef.title: abductee
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was born on an Imperial world but abducted in a raid by a heretical warband in which [PAWN_possessive] family was bloodily murdered. [PAWN_pronoun] barely remembers [PAWN_possessive] parents, and has embraced the possibilities of [PAWN_possessive] new life enthusiastically.

BackstoryDef.title: abductee
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was born on an Imperial world but abducted in a raid by a heretical warband in which [PAWN_possessive] family was bloodily murdered. [PAWN_pronoun] remembers enough to resent having been snatched from [PAWN_possessive] old life, and has never got over it.

BackstoryDef.title: cultist child
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised among a cult worshipping the Ruinous Powers. [PAWN_pronoun] was involved in cult rituals from an early age and was repulsed by them, but found it difficult to escape the cult.

BackstoryDef.title: noble child
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in unimaginable privilege as the child of a noble family secretly devoted to the Ruinous Powers. [PAWN_possessive] family had everything they could ever ask for, and a lot more besides, but they still wanted more, and went to any lengths to get it.

BackstoryDef.title: agricultural labourer
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] worked as a fieldhand on an agriworld occupied by the forces of Chaos. [PAWN_pronoun] spent 14-hour shifts tending to endless fields of tainted crops and herds of mutated livestock.

BackstoryDef.title: manufactorum worker
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] worked on a production line in a gargantuan manufactorum under the auspices of the Dark Mechanicum. [PAWN_possessive] days were spent on repetitive tasks and backbreaking labour, but at least [PAWN_pronoun] survived the experience.

BackstoryDef.title: Mechanicum thrall
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was a thrall in the service of the Dark Mechanicum. Thralls are used for menial work of all kinds and treated as completely expendable in the search for esoteric knowledge. [PAWN_pronoun] was lucky not to be worked to death or sacrificed in some dark ritual.

BackstoryDef.title: voidsman
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] served in the lower decks of a voidship crewed by heretics, performing skilled tasks, carrying weapons during boarding actions, and living in constant fear of death or worse at the hands of capricious would-be champions of the Four.

BackstoryDef.title: noble
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was a noble secretly devoted to the Ruinous Powers. [PAWN_possessive] life was one of luxury, cruelty, and bloodletting, and [PAWN_pronoun] took a personal interest in dark rituals intended to grant [PAWN_objective] ever-greater strength and power.

BackstoryDef.title: PDF turncoat
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was part of [PAWN_possessive] homeworld's Planetary Defence Forces and trained in the basic use of a lasgun and bayonet. Unfortunately for [PAWN_possessive] PDF comrades, [PAWN_pronoun] also belonged to a secretive heretic fraternity, and participated in a bloody mutiny and massacre of the unsuspecting defenders during an invasion of [PAWN_possessive] world. [PAWN_pronoun] welcomed its liberation from the Imperium's reign of terror.
